fields.statement: Verified f5cb4e13e at HEAD: re-ran its Checks: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/run/..., ./internal/api/..., ./internal/guide/... exit 0; ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/describe-golden -update exit 0 with no golden diff; -run 'TestScripts/(describe-golden|run-review-journal)' exit 0; rhiza ship generate exit 0 (0 files changed); rhiza render exit 0.
